P.h: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day exploited in the wild
P.p: Ivanti warned of a new authentication bypass in its Connect Secure VPN that is being actively exploited. It needs low complexity to run arbitrary commands. Volexity saw a threat actor chain it with two other flaws to get root on vulnerable devices.
P.s: Treat every internet-facing ICS appliance as exposed until patched. Hunt for unexpected root-level commands and integrity-check failures, and watch for Ivanti's fix and mitigation guidance.

items.h: GitLab patches CVSS 10.0 flaw in CI/CD regex validation
items.d: CVE-2026-97229 is an integer overflow that could let unauthenticated users run code on the server. Fixed in 19.2.8, 19.3.5 and 19.4.2, along with XSS and cache-poisoning bugs.

items.h: Meta: hackers took code and data of 1,500 people from GitHub
items.d: 99% of stolen data was source code; personal data was mostly synthetic test data. Meta is rotating exposed secrets and adding guardrails.

items.h: Racket signing keys leaked via compromised build server
items.d: A crypto miner on a Northwestern University server exposed Apple and Windows keys. Windows cert revoked; macOS 8.12 to 9.3 users should reinstall.

items.h: Exposed AWS keys are probed for Bedrock access
items.d: Datadog saw harvesting platforms call ListFoundationModels, InvokeModel and Converse to test what stolen credentials can reach.

P.h: Anthropic replaces git with in-house Scion after 30,000 daily merges
P.p: AI-generated code pushed Anthropic's monorepo to about 30,000 merged changes a day. It built Scion, a centralized version control system with server-side commits and sparse checkouts, and migrated off git in five months.
P.s: CPU and memory needs fell 200x versus the old git mirroring setup, and CI checkouts dropped from minutes to seconds.

P.h: AWS Lambda Web Functions runs ordinary web servers, no handler rewrite
P.p: Deploy existing Node.js servers built with Express or Next.js straight to Lambda. The service handles scaling and multi-region distribution, each environment serves up to 128 concurrent requests, and billing follows active CPU time.
P.s: Available today in five regions. Google also shipped a rewritten second edition of its SRE book covering AI and platform engineering.
